title: CLAUDE.md
text: Parameter sequences (parseq.R, seq.R): Functions like parseq_fct(), parseq_cv(), parseq_range(), parseq_manual() attach sens_values attribute mrgsolve model object. seq_geo(), seq_fct(), seq_even(), seq_cv() generate underlying numeric sequences. Sensitivity simulation (sens_each.R, sens_grid.R): sens_each() varies one parameter time (OAT); sens_grid() full factorial combinations via expand.grid(). convert parameter lists idata (individual-level data) call mrgsolve’s simulation engine. Output nested tibble columns p_name, .value, data. Visualization (sens_plot.R): sens_plot() dispatches sens_each sens_grid class. Supports layouts: default (patchwork grid), facet_grid, facet_wrap, list. Reference case (nominal parameter values) plotted black dashed line. Local sensitivity analysis (lsa.R): lsa() perturbs parameter eps (default 1e-7) computes finite-difference sensitivities. Output plot.lsa() S3 method. Convenience wrapper (sens_run.R): sens_run() accepts method= (“factor”, “cv”, “range”, “manual”) vary= (“”, “grid”) combine parseq + sens one call.

mrgsim.sa 0.3.0
text: Add palette argument sens_plot() sens_each sens_grid output, allowing users pass discrete color scale (e.g., ggplot2 ggsci). default palette uses lattice/trellis colors small numbers levels hcl.colors(palette = "Dark 2") larger sets (#13). Add group facet arguments sens_plot() sens_grid() output control sensitivity variable used within-panel color grouping variable(s) appear facet strips. Add xlab ylab arguments sens_plot() sens_grid() output (#15). ylab can now vector; length must match length dv_name multiple dependent variables requested (#15). Add palette argument lsa_plot() allowing users pass discrete color scale; pal argument deprecated; use palette instead.
